indexObservation.sourceTitle: How much do hostels cost around the world? Hostel Price Index for 2023 - Price of Travel
indexObservation.evidenceText: The Price of Travel Hostel Index table lists Lisbon, Portugal, Lisbon Destination Hostel, at $17.76 per night. Its methodology states that the price is for one person in a shared dorm room, including taxes and fees, using the average of a Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023.
indexObservation.referencePeriod: Average Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023; article dated 2023-01-16.
indexObservation.searchQuery: site:priceoftravel.com/how-much-do-hostels-cost-around-the-world Lisbon Portugal Hostel Index dorm bed price
indexObservation.reason: Exact city row and source-defined one-person shared-dorm observation found; no conversion or ratio calculated.

currentBenchmark.evidenceText: Booking.com search results for Lisbon Destination Hostel in Lisbon show a Bunk Bed in 10-Bed Mixed Dormitory Room, maximum people 1 / only for 1 guest, at US$29 per night. The result explicitly says the €4 city tax per person per night and 6% VAT are excluded; it also displays the three-night total of US$87, which was not used as the nightly value.
currentBenchmark.referencePeriod: Booking search result displayed a three-night stay; retrieved 2026-08-01.
currentBenchmark.searchQuery: Lisbon Destination Hostel current shared dorm bed one person nightly price taxes included
currentBenchmark.reason: Exact named property and city, one-person mixed-dorm bed, explicit nightly price, currency, and tax basis found in one result of the single public search operation; no arithmetic performed.
